crossRefs.note: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.
A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
“Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.
Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else…
crossRefs.keyword: ignorant. Heb. I knew not. as a

crossRefs.note: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”
crossRefs.keyword: ignorant. Heb. I knew not. as a

translations.web: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
translations.bsb: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.
translations.kjv: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast
translations.asv: So brutish was I, and ignorant; I was as a beast before thee.
